lookups.why: Check whether `pub mod openhuman;` or a re-export from the crate root exists, so the new import path `use openhuman_core as oh;` compiles.

value.summary: The change renames the crate import from `openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `openhuman_core as oh`. Without reading the crate's `lib.rs` to check whether `openhuman` is re-exported from the crate root, this would cause a compilation error if the module is not re-exported at the top level. Needs a lookup of `crates/openhuman-core/src/lib.rs` to confirm whether the re-export exists.
